s: kindness is enjoined by Luqman's son (as an exhortation)
q: and enjoin kindness

s: iniquity is forbidden by Luqman's son (as an exhortation)
q: and forbid iniquity,

s: the wise Scripture is a revelations (wise)
q: These are revelations of the wise Scripture,

s: Allah's favours are loaded upon mankind (both without and within)
q: and hath loaded you with His favours both without and within?

s: the devil invites mankind (unto the doom of flame)
q: What! Even though the devil were inviting them unto the doom of flame?

s: disbelievers return to Allah
q: And whosoever disbelieveth, let not his disbelief afflict thee (O Muhammad). Unto Us is their return,

s: the Hereafter is believed in by those who establish worship and pay the poor-due (with sure faith)
q: Those who establish worship and pay the poor-due and have sure faith in the Hereafter.

s: the sun is subdued by Allah (to do its work)
q: and hath subdued the sun and the moon (to do their work),

s: revelations provide guidance (for the good)
q: A guidance and a mercy for the good,

s: the moon is subdued by Allah (to do its work)
q: and hath subdued the sun and the moon (to do their work),

s: the signs of Allah are denied by traitors (every traitor ingrate)
q: None denieth Our signs save every traitor ingrate.

s: the Day is fearful mankind (because the parent and child cannot avail one another)
q: O mankind! Keep your duty to your Lord and fear a Day when the parent will not be able to avail the child in aught, nor the child to avail the parent.

s: the life of the world beguiles mankind (if they allow it)
q: Let not the life of the world beguile you,

s: the Hour is known by Allah (with Him is knowledge of it)
q: Lo! Allah! With Him is knowledge of the Hour.

s: rain is sent down by Allah
q: He sendeth down the rain,

s: the wombs are known by Allah (in their contents)
q: and knoweth that which is in the wombs.

s: revelations provide mercy (for the good)
q: A guidance and a mercy for the good,

s: Allah is a the Absolute (Owner of Praise)
q: Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.

s: Allah is a the Creator (of the heavens and the earth)
q: If thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they would answer: Allah.

s: Allah is a the Mighty
q: Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

s: Allah is a the Wise
q: Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

s: Allah is a the Hearer
q: Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

s: Allah is a the Knower
q: Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

s: Allah is a the Sublime
q: because Allah, He is the Sublime, the Great.

s: Allah is a the Great
q: because Allah, He is the Sublime, the Great.

s: Allah is a the True
q: That (is so) because Allah, He is the True,
